questions.nlq: Could you tell me how many open complaints my customers have, and for each product category the average price of the products they complained about, also showing the same numbers for closed complaints, ranking the categories by the number of complaints?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The user is the regional manager for the state of Kansas, so "my customers" are those rows in the Customers table where state = 'Kansas'.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT
    p.product_category_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.complaint_status_code = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_complaints,
    AVG(CASE WHEN c.complaint_status_code = 'Open' THEN p.product_price END) AS avg_price_open,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_complaints,
    AVG(CASE WHEN c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed' THEN p.product_price END) AS avg_price_closed
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE cu.state = 'Kansas'
GROUP BY p.product_category_code
ORDER BY (open_complaints + closed_complaints) DESC;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The user is the regional manager for the state of Hawaii, so "my customers" are those rows in the Customers table where state = 'Hawaii'.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH hawaii_complaints AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.product_category_code, p.product_price
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE cu.state = 'Hawaii'
),
overall_open AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_total
    FROM hawaii_complaints
    WHERE complaint_status_code = 'Open'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT open_total FROM overall_open) AS open_complaints_total,
    hc.product_category_code,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN hc.complaint_status_code = 'Open' THEN 1 END) AS open_complaints,
    AVG(CASE WHEN hc.complaint_status_code = 'Open' THEN hc.product_price END) AS open_average_price,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN hc.complaint_status_code = 'Closed' THEN 1 END) AS closed_complaints,
    AVG(CASE WHEN hc.complaint_status_code = 'Closed' THEN hc.product_price END) AS closed_average_price
FROM hawaii_complaints hc
GROUP BY hc.product_category_code
ORDER BY (COUNT(CASE WHEN hc.complaint_status_code IN ('Open','Closed') THEN 1 END)) DESC;
